name: Onyx 1
description: By 4 ABY, shortly before the Battle of Endor, Sienar Fleet Systems began manufacturing TIE/D Defenders for the Galactic Empire. Onyx 1 was one such TIE/D Defender produced during that time, with the starfighter's design intended to emulate advantages of starfighters fighting for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Onyx 1's crew consisted of a TIE pilot, and the Defender was armed with laser cannons, ion cannons, and missile launchers.
